propositions: Commit 8f4c5fdb0d3 canonicalized openai model specs to 'openai-chat:' qualifier and updated the unit-tier matrix gate but not the live external tier's provider name consumers, causing a false positive guard failure.

The live external tier's credential map _PROVIDER_KEY_ENV has no 'openai-chat' entry, so configured_provider() returns 'openai-chat', credential_present() returns False, and live_llm_ready() returns False, causing all live LLM tests on the openai arm to skip.

The provider guard test compares resolved specs literally against REBAR_EXPECTED_LLM_PROVIDER='openai' (the family name) but now receives 'openai-chat:' (the qualifier), causing AssertionError at line 88.

The fix introduces a qualifier-to-family mapping and provider_family() helper in the live tier to align with the unit tier's _MODEL_QUALIFIER_BY_PROVIDER, making all consumers agree on the family name.
Unit regression tests confirm configured_provider() returns the family name and live_llm_ready() is True when the openai overlay and OPENAI_API_KEY credential are present.
